title: Blue Mountain Beach "Bella Vita" 56 Blue Mountain Road Unit B203
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Bella Vita" 56 Blue Mountain Road Unit B203
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Walking distance from the beach- Overlooks 350 feet of private deeded beach- 2 dedicated parking spots- 2 Gulf front pools- Gated community- Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience beautiful coastal living at Bella Vita, a single-story condo nestled on the shores of Blue Mountain Beach. Sleeping 9, with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, this charming retreat is perfect for families or small groups. Enjoy lounging beside the 2 brilliant blue pools while taking in the Gulf view. Dedicated beach access steps from the building encourages spending every day playing in the gentle waves. With Blue Mountain Beach Creamery’s delicious treats a quick walk away and the area’s range of water activities, including kayaking, paddleboarding, and fishing, this property is the perfect destination for a dreamy coastal stay!Step inside this elegant haven to find a sprawling great room adorned with warm Mediterranean touches and tile floors—ideal for easy clean up after a day at the beach. The spacious kitchen is a chef’s delight, with tons of counter space, a large 6-burner range, and a sizeable island with an attached breakfast bar for 3—plenty of room to prep and entertain at the same time! In the living space, comfy seating accented with rattan adds a touch of Caribbean flair as guests watch TV or enjoy the water view. Continue onto the balcony, where a high-top table invites leisurely mornings sipping coffee beneath the breezy ceiling fan. Unwind for the night in the vast primary bedroom, featuring a lovely king bed, luxurious bathroom, and balcony access. Another king bed is in the first guest bedroom, while the second has a queen. Kids and families will appreciate the bunk room, with a twin-over-queen bed. All the bedrooms conveniently feature a private bathroom, and there is an in-unit laundry room.When the beach calls, get away to Bella Vista for a relaxing Blue Mountain Beach vacation filled with pool days and coastal fun. Dedicated parking for 2 vehicles makes it easy to explore other 30A communities, such as Grayton Beach and Seaside. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 9):- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, management fines.

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Blue Mountain Beach "Bella Vita" 56 Blue Mountain Road Unit B203 Santa Rosa Beach, Florida Bedrooms 4 Beds 5 Sleeps 9 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf views - Walking distance from the beach - Overlooks 350 feet of private deeded beach - 2 dedicated parking spots - 2 Gulf front pools - Gated community - Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Experience beautiful coastal living at Bella Vita, a single-story condo nestled on the shores of Blue Mountain Beach. Sleeping 9, with 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, this charming retreat is perfect for families or small groups. Enjoy lounging beside the 2 brilliant blue pools while taking in the Gulf view. Dedicated beach access steps from the building encourages spending every day playing in the gentle waves. With Blue Mountain Beach Creamery’s delicious treats a quick walk away and the area’s range of water activities, including kayaking, paddleboarding, and fishing, this property is the perfect destination for a dreamy coastal stay! Step inside this elegant haven to find a sprawling great room adorned with warm Mediterranean touches and tile floors—ideal for easy clean up after a day at the beach. The spacious kitchen is a chef’s delight, with tons of counter space, a large 6-burner range, and a sizeable island with an attached breakfast bar for 3—plenty of room to prep and entertain at the same time! In the living space, comfy seating accented with rattan adds a touch of Caribbean flair as guests watch TV or enjoy the water view. Continue onto the balcony, where a high-top table invites leisurely mornings sipping coffee beneath the breezy ceiling fan. Unwind for the night in the vast primary bedroom, featuring a lovely king bed, luxurious bathroom, and balcony access. Another king bed is in the first guest bedroom, while the second has a queen. Kids and families will appreciate the bunk room, with a twin-over-queen bed. All the bedrooms conveniently feature a private bathroom, and there is an in-unit laundry room. When the beach calls, get away to Bella Vista for a relaxing Blue Mountain Beach vacation filled with pool days and coastal fun. Dedicated parking for 2 vehicles makes it easy to explore other 30A communities, such as Grayton Beach and Seaside. Book today!
